description: Straßen is a dataset listed in GDI-DE, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by Bundesamt für Kartographie und Geodäsie. Road network as a basis for noise mapping according to the EU Ambient Noise Directive includes major roads and additional roads According to § 47b BImSchG, main roads are "Bundesfernstraße, Landesstraße or other cross-border roads, each with a traffic volume of more than three million motor vehicles per year". Coverage: DE. The portal shows the English title as "streets" (machine-translated by the portal). The listing shows 2022-01-31 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support transport network, traffic and access studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-gdi-de.
